chunks: And whatever is in it from ʿAṭāʾ ibn Al-Sāʾib, I have narrated it from Al-Ḥusayn ibn Aḥmad ibn Idrīs — may Allah be pleased with him — from his father, from Muḥammad ibn Abī Al-Ṣahbān, from Abū Aḥmad Muḥammad ibn Ziyād Al-Azdī, from Abān Al-Aḥmar, from ʿAṭāʾ ibn Al-Sāʾib.

key_terms.أَبَانَ الْأَحْمَرِ: A transmitter in the sanad/isnad linking to ʿAṭāʾ ibn Al-Sāʾib.
key_terms.الْأَزْدِيِّ: A nisbah identifying Muḥammad ibn Ziyād as belonging to Azd.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I narrated it; a transmission formula indicating the author’s route of narration.
key_terms.عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ: A narrator from whom these reports are transmitted.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain for narrations from ʿAṭāʾ ibn Al-Sāʾib in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu Al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage is a sanad/isnad statement identifying the transmission chain for reports narrated from ʿAṭāʾ ibn Al-Sāʾib in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu Al-Faqīh. Its significance lies in documenting the route of transmission, which is essential in hadith sciences and the study of source authority.
